verdict.rationale: Content was extracted from many published guidance pages on www.sos.state.tx.us, including the corp index, forms directory, copies page and SOSPortal instructions. That shows the public reading surface was reachable without a key. supp-3 also notes the forms directory and instructions are downloadable without an account. The robots.txt that bans AI agents by name applies to the separate direct.sos.state.tx.us filing host, not this guidance surface. missing for 10: an explicit probe of the www host (HTTP status, robots.txt, identified user agent used) confirming no bot wall, CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, and independent corroboration of agent access.
